01 THE BIG PICTURE

Not just the player.
The possibilities of play.

Games have always been a meeting point for intelligence and imagination. Foundation models are opening new ways to participate in both.

AI can control a character, predict a world, propose a level, work inside a game engine, generate a conversation, or help find a bug. These applications share tools and model families, but they solve different problems.

This collection brings their literature together—from foundational Game AI to recent language, vision, and code-based systems. Browse by topic, follow a concrete example, or go straight to the original work.
